response.sql:
WITH per_race_name AS (
  SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS average_points
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE ds.points >= 1.0
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_points) AS overall_average
  FROM per_race_name
)
SELECT p.name, p.average_points, p.average_points - o.overall_average AS difference
FROM per_race_name AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL
  AND p.average_points > o.overall_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct races.name is one group, so averages across races sharing a name are combined before the overall average is calculated.
